[[File:Imperial_Knights_Training_Facility.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Imperial Knights Training Facility]]
The '''Imperial Knights Training Facility''' was a training academy on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for the [[Imperial Knight]]s following the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. In [[138 ABY]], Master [[Yalta Val]] was appointed the [[Prefect/Legends|Prefect]] of the Imperial Knights Training Facility and tasked with finding new recruits. Val was an effective teacher and his students participated in the [[Liberation of Mon Calamari Shipyards|liberation]] of the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]]. The following year, in [[139 ABY]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] visited the training facility to inform Val of a new [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]] campaign to hunt down war criminals.
